notes: A fixed plan with a per-request allowance, not per-token rates: Go is billed monthly and carries 5-hour / weekly / monthly windows plus a per-model monthly dollar limit, and Zen is prepaid credits charged per request. presets.js declares billing mode 'flat' with a per-request window, and the plan card is read from the router's plan-usage route rather than from a rate table, so no rate is copied here. The Go / Go Plus / Go Team tiers and their limits are vendor figures that change without notice; re-check the linked plan page before trusting a limit. Model coverage per tier is catalog-dependent.
